_meta.method: Titles and abstracts were read by a language model to pull out explicitly stated K540E prevalence figures, association statements and first-report claims, each with a verbatim quote. A program then kept only items whose quote appears word for word in the abstract and, for prevalence, contains both the stated number and "540". No human checked them.
caveats: Abstract statements only; full texts were not read, so most papers contribute no figure.
Definitions differ between papers (mixed infections, populations, pooled or median values from reviews). Do not compare figures as if they were one survey series.
numerator and denominator are present only when both appear in the quote.
countries_iso3 is machine-assigned from the abstract.
in_graph means the paper's PubMed ID is in the System Public Graph CSV snapshot.

abstract_associations are sentences from abstracts that link K540E or a K540E-containing haplotype to an outcome. Many are background statements rather than results of that study. Show the quote itself; do not restate it as a finding or infer a direction.

For the 10 papers the System graph has read, the findings it extracted are included in k540e-graph.json under findings_from_k540e_papers, each with its study_id. These were counted against the CSV snapshot; all 21 of them are in the vetted ID list. One (4avf24yKnZ) was compared against its paper.
_meta.licence: Bibliographic metadata from PubMed; quotes are short excerpts from abstracts, shown with attribution and a link to the source.
